{"implementation":"def solve(case):
    lengths = case["lengths"]
    scores = case["scores"]
    budget = case["budget"]
    n = len(lengths)
    # dp[b] = (score, tokens, indices_tuple) for exact budget b, or None
    dp = [None] * (budget + 1)
    dp[0] = (0.0, 0, ())  # score as float, tokens, indices
    for i, (l, s) in enumerate(zip(lengths, scores)):
        for b in range(budget, l - 1, -1):
            prev = dp[b - l]
            if prev is not None:
                new_score = prev[0] + s
                new_tokens = prev[1] + l
                new_indices = prev[2] + (i,)
                cand = (new_score, new_tokens, new_indices)
                cur = dp[b]
                if cur is None:
                    dp[b] = cand
                else:
                    # compare by score (higher better), then -tokens (higher = fewer tokens better), then indices lexicographically
                    if (cand[0], -cand[1], cand[2]) > (cur[0], -cur[1], cur[2]):
                        dp[b] = cand
    # find best among all budgets
    best = max((v for v in dp if v is not None), key=lambda x: (x[0], -x[1], x[2]))
    best_score, best_tokens, best_indices = best
    return {
        "selected_indices": list(best_indices),
        "tokens_used": best_tokens,
        "total_score": best_score
    }"}
